ValidationRule.description: COI / W-9 / Food Services Certificate Collected can only be changed by the Upload Certificate flow (which flips Certificate_Flow_Update__c in the same save). Blocks manual edits by every user, including administrators.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ISNEW(), OR(COI_Collected__c, W_9_Collected__c, Food_Services_Certificate_Collected__c), AND( OR( ISCHANGED(COI_Collected__c), ISCHANGED(W_9_Collected__c), ISCHANGED(Food_Services_Certificate_Collected__c) ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Certificate_Flow_Update__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: COI Collected, W-9 Collected and Food Services Certificate Collected are set automatically when a certificate is uploaded. Please use the Upload Certificate button instead of editing these fields.
